channel.title: Verafy Harness release notes
channel.description: What changed in each version of Verafy Harness and its spec.

item.title: Verafy Harness v0.0.2-alpha: run it anywhere
item.description: The harness daemon, verafy up for every cloud, a testnet on one machine, a Solana ruling program, proof packing end to end, a calibration set, the Banker as a service, and a Learn section.

item.title: Verafy Harness v0.0.1-alpha: the first spec, scored
item.description: The first versioned spec, a scoring pass that checks it against the code, multi-model routing with calibration and audits, proof packing routed, and the economics rewritten.
